name: ticket
description: Get a new ticket as an HttpOnly cookie. Supports tickets via cookies.

params.name: password
params.description:
The secret password. This can also be a valid ticket. Only optional if the ticket is
provided in a cookie header and only if the endpoint supports this.

params.name: path
params.description: Verify ticket, and check if user have access 'privs' on 'path'.

params.name: privs
params.description: Verify ticket, and check if user have access 'privs' on 'path'.

params.name: tfa-challenge
params.description: The signed TFA challenge string the user wants to respond to.

returns.description: The API response for a ticket call.

ticket.description:
The ticket as is supposed to be used in the authentication header. Not provided here if the
endpoint uses HttpOnly cookies to supply the actual ticket.

ticket-info.description:
Like a full ticket, except the signature is missing. Useful in HttpOnly-contexts
(browsers).
